business_quality_reasoning: Stanley Electrical Services has traded since 2012 with micro accounts and 37 five-star Google reviews — a long-established family-run local electrician. Rates are published (£50/hr, £289/day), showing a clear commercial model.
price_point_reasoning: The listing itself publishes rates of £50/hr or £289/day, so a typical domestic job lands around £150-£250.
modernity_gap: There is no website at all — only a third-party directory profile on hamuch.com with a masked phone number and stock photo, so the business is a full generation behind having any web presence.
site_weaknesses: The business has no website of its own — its entire web presence is a directory profile on hamuch.com
The phone number is masked by the directory (0747950xxxx), so even the listing does not let customers call directly
A stock tradesman photo stands in for any real imagery of the business, team or work
No services detail beyond two rate rows — no rewiring, EV, certification or emergency information a customer would search for
Directory branding (HaMuch logos, 'Get a quote' funnel, footer links to competitors 'near London') means enquiries flow through a platform the business does not control
site_analysis: This is not the business's website — it is a HaMuch directory listing, and Stanley Electrical Services appears to have no site of its own. The listing shows the basics (name, Mitcham CR4, two rate rows at £50/hr and a short about paragraph) but masks the phone number, uses stock imagery and sits inside the directory's own branding and quote funnel. Every weakness points the same way: this business has no web presence it controls.
review_summary: Right now your only shop window is a directory listing that hides your phone number, uses a stock photo and sits under someone else's brand next to links for other electricians. Twelve years of trading and 37 five-star reviews deserve better than that. Your own website would put your name, your number and your reviews in front of customers directly.
outreach_angle: Your only web presence is a HaMuch listing that masks your phone number — customers cannot even call you without going through the directory.
